method: Full semantic reading, source/build/artifact hash verification and printed axiom inspection. No independent rebuild.
findings: The synthesized finite sum may have nonunique coefficients. weighted_kernel proves its weighted image vanishes whenever the synthesized vector does, using all exponential probes, a complex derivative of a finite sum and totality.
The conjugate z in the probe h+conj(z)f correctly compensates conjugate-linearity of the first inner-product argument, yielding the holomorphic exponential exp(<h,g>+z<f,g>).

The chosen preimage therefore defines a genuine linear map on the actual span of exponential vectors. Its partial-map domain is that span, and density follows from the previously constructed totality on the same Fock space.
The vacuum annihilation and nonzero test use the actual exponential kernel. The output is nonzero for f nonzero, not a vacuous zero operator.
scope_limits: No boundedness, closability, adjoint creation operator or CCR has been claimed here.
The parameter f is a one-particle vector; no physical spacetime smearing, charge, Maxwell field or stress tensor is identified by this construction.
